title: Commercial & Property Manager Service Agreements Volume Rebate: Basis and Questions Answered
content:
**Basis.** After a term ends, the agreement earns a volume rebate of the tier's rebate percentage of the paid mitigation invoices of the customer in that term above the tier's rebate threshold, capped at the tier's rebate cap and rounded to the cent, half up; it is earned only once the agreement has completed the tier's minimum consecutive paid terms, and it is credited within the tier's rebate claim window days after the term ends. Tiers with a 0.00 threshold and a 0.0 percentage earn no rebate.

This basis governs the volume rebate of the Commercial & Property Manager Service Agreements. The rebate is credited to the agreement once per term.

## Questions answered

**What counts as the paid mitigation invoices of the customer in a term?**
The total of the customer payments and insurance postings on the customer's water, fire and mold jobs (its Water Damage Mitigation, Fire & Smoke Mitigation and Mold Remediation jobs) posted within that completed agreement term.

**When is the rebate determined?**
After the term ends. It is determined for one completed term at a time.

**How much is the rebate?**
The tier's rebate percentage of the paid mitigation invoices of the customer in that term above the tier's rebate threshold, capped at the tier's rebate cap, and rounded to the cent, half up.

**Is there a qualifying period?**
Yes. The rebate is earned only once the agreement has completed the tier's minimum consecutive paid terms.

**By when is it credited?**
Within the tier's rebate claim window days after the term ends.

**Which tiers earn nothing?**
Tiers with a 0.00 threshold and a 0.0 percentage earn no rebate.

## Illustrations (hypothetical figures, not any tier's schedule)

Assume an illustrative threshold of 40,000.00, an illustrative percentage of 3.0 and an illustrative cap of 2,000.00, on an agreement that has completed the minimum consecutive paid terms.

| Paid mitigation invoices in the completed term | Outcome |
|---|---|
| 38,500.00 | nothing lies above the 40,000.00 threshold; no rebate |
| 120,000.00 | the percentage applied to the paid invoices above the threshold exceeds 2,000.00, so the rebate is capped at 2,000.00 |

On the same illustrative figures, an agreement that has not yet completed the minimum consecutive paid terms earns no rebate for the term, whatever its paid mitigation invoices.
